quality_axes.interpretation: One fictional job produced the same committed state with and without the gate. No quality improvement was established. The gate accepted after one refinement; the conservative reducer still downgraded one requested completed state in both arms. Source-support probabilities do not authorize workflow-state changes or verify external truth.
quality_axes.pre_pruning_limit: The production gate checks model proposals before conservative pruning. Another job may be rejected by the gate even when conservative commit would omit an unproved edge or downgrade a state. This comparison does not change that ordering.
